sentences.en: We must presuppose that the wage paid is economically just.
sentences.zh: 我们必须假设支付的工资是合理的。

sentences.en: Conversation between two people presupposes four attentive ears.
sentences.zh: 两个人之间的对话需要四个专注的听众作为前提。

sentences.en: You can't run a business without presupposing some level of customer demand.
sentences.zh: 没有假设一定的客户需求，你就无法经营这家企业。

senses.zh: 预先假定, 假设,以…为先决条件, 意味着
